// AUDIO VIDEO IMAGE MANIPULATION

> VIDEO EDITORS

MATCHING RECORDS: 5

  • Opus Clip:
    AI video repurposing utility that automatically extracts highlight clips from long-form video and formats them into vertical shorts.
  • Descript:
    Document-style audio and video editor featuring transcript-based editing, filler word removal, and synthetic voice cloning.
  • Kdenlive:
    Free and open-source non-linear video editor; powerful local-first alternative featuring multi-track editing and plain-text XML project files.
  • OpenShot:
    A simple, cross-platform video editor designed for quick cuts, basic sequencing, and multi-track audio/video mixing.
  • Subtitle Edit:
    An advanced open-source editor for creating, syncing, translating, and fixing subtitle files with waveform visualization.
